subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

I prefer tea **than coffee.**
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. to coffee .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **prefer** is always followed by the preposition **to** when making a comparison between two things.
 
• Using **than** after "prefer" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• For example:
 
 
• Correct: I prefer tea **to** coffee.
 
• Incorrect: I prefer tea **than** coffee.
 
 

Correct sentence: *I prefer tea **to coffee**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Usage of Prefer:**

 
 
• When using "prefer" with verbs, we use the structure **prefer + verb-ing + to + verb-ing.**
 
• Example: I prefer reading **to** watching television.
 
 
 
• **Other Notes:**
 
 
• The phrase "prefer to" is widely used to express likes or choices between two options.
 
• It is a standard grammatical structure in English, especially in formal contexts.
